component.name: cpcpub
component.summary: Measure the processor's cores and compare the results

description.p: A small CPU benchmark and a window to run it from. It measures integer and floating-point latency and throughput, integer multiply, memory bandwidth and random-access latency, and indirect-call throughput and branch-predictor capacity -- with every thread at once, and each core on its own.

The window builds the benchmark's command line, shows it before it runs, and lays the results out in a table with every column explained. A result can be uploaded to a results hub to compare with other machines.
